about.text: I'm half designer and half frontend developer, is that makes me a incomplete professional? I don't think so, probably the opposite, because everything I do always need to be the best a can do. Not only working on a project but also for life... could be studying to learn a new skill or improve another, handling with people I try to give my full attention for what they're saying, even with my hobbies, like to play an instrument, this is my goal... I'll do my best, trust me.
